description: Rewrites say with a person-pronoun calque to say to that person only when with + pronoun is the immediate complement and the tail is allowlisted.
fp_risk_note: High risk. With is valid in parentheticals, absolute constructions, questions, manner phrases, and many non-calque structures. V1 only fires on say/says/said/saying + with + pronoun when with + pronoun is the immediate complement and the pronoun tail is explicitly allowlisted. It blocks intervening direct objects, comma-before-with parentheticals, fronted wh-object questions, and any non-allowlisted tail.

positive.input: I want to say with you.
positive.expectedCorrection: I want to say to you.
positive.notes: Say with you is a Vietnamese transfer pattern; with + pronoun is the immediate complement.
The pronoun is followed by an allowlisted time adverbial.

positive.input: He says with her every day.
positive.expectedCorrection: He says to her every day.
positive.notes: The frequency tail is explicitly allowlisted.

negative.notes: Intervening direct object means with me is not the immediate complement of say.

negative.input: She said with him beside me.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him beside me.
negative.notes: Beside me is a non-allowlisted tail.

negative.input: I would say, with him, that it's wrong.
negative.expectedCorrection: I would say, with him, that it's wrong.

negative.input: What are you saying with them?
negative.expectedCorrection: What are you saying with them?

negative.notes: Absolute construction tail is not allowlisted.
Absolute construction tail is not allowlisted.
There-tail absolute construction is not allowlisted.
Rule only applies to say verb forms.
Talk with is valid and not in scope.
Manner phrase with confidence is valid.
